cited_by.title: Men's afro hair: waves, fades, durags and the nape

record.design: Prevalence survey of clean-shave haircut bleeding and folliculitis keloidalis nuchae
record.finding: Haircut-associated bleeding and FKN were studied in men who wear the very close "chiskop" haircut; FKN prevalence was similar to published population data. The abstract is truncated beyond that in the record read.
record.note: Only the first part of the abstract was read; the bleeding result is not quoted.
